case.title: Fabricator changes phone time zone so wall-clock times look hours apart while instants are 15 min apart

submissions.open_text: Supply rationing schedule changes without any notice.
Handwashing station at the clinic lacks soap often.
Flooding last season contaminated the shallow well.
Youth group sells cleaned water at a small profit.

case.why: An adversarial case: the fabricator switches the phone's time zone between fake interviews. In UTC the four submissions are a 06:00Z, b 06:15Z, c 06:30Z and d 06:45Z. In Nairobi time that is 09:00, 09:15, 09:30 and 09:45, so 4 enumerator submissions fall within 45 minutes and burst fires on b. An implementation that compares the wall-clock part of captured_at and ignores the offset sees 06:30, 07:15, 09:00 and 10:45. Those span 4h15, no 60-minute window holds more than 2, and it misses the burst. The other checks stay quiet. In project time every submission is 09:00-09:45, so off_hours does not fire. Even a naive wall-clock reading keeps the earliest at 06:30, which is not before 06:00. Durations are at least 720 s. Points are at least about 500 m apart and all inside Kondele. There are no shared content words, no voice notes, and one device.
